title: 第95章 鬼手毒尊天赋异禀第94章 只能看看不中用啊
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
姬云天之所以把话说给青狸，是因为青狸与青鸳不同，青鸳从大家族中成长，做事有规矩有底线。而青狸是在血兽谷长大，没有那么多约束，只要不是要人性命，搞点事情，对青狸来说没有什么心理上的负担，她还会搞出事情后，在一边吃瓜看戏。所以事情说给青狸，青狸十有八九会做的。
姬云天安排完青狸，直接通过传送大阵前往苍天城了。
苍天城西，云梦大泽之畔。这是姬云天为苍天银号打造的天空之城，按照姬云天的想法，这里就应该是所有人心中向往的地方，姬云天将姬家所有阵法师在这里全力打造了半个月，用阵法将一座城悬在半空，这里灵气如雨，法则凝实，是整个苍天城最繁华的核心地带，也可以说是苍天大世界的最繁华地带。
此城仅凭上古大阵悬浮于空，由巨大阵法凝结出的四个大字苍天银号闪耀于空。
苍天银号大殿之内，不见金银俗物，只见一条由灵石铺就的长河在脚下流淌，河水潺潺，全是切割规整的极品灵石。
大殿两侧，坐着十二位掌柜，个个气息深沉，最低也是天仙境中阶修士。还有五位真仙境修士。
大殿正中的高台上，姬云天端坐于一张由星辰石打造而成的宽大龙椅中。
现在他是掌控着整个盟内经济命脉的苍天银号掌舵人，同时也是传承了三万年之久的姬家的现任族长，在这里，他感觉自己才更真实，几个时辰之前被婆媳双打的那个人，怎么可能是自己。
姬云天手中的传信玉符突然闪烁起来。姬云天打开，听到了姬长空的声音。姬长空现在正在天魔城处理族中事务。
“族长，天魔域这边有情报。玄冥宫意图攻打邻近的烈天教，吞并其灵脉，特向银号申请一笔战争贷款，数额三百亿极品灵石。”此言一出，大殿内数位掌柜眉头微皱。三百亿极品灵石，足以买下一个类似于苍玄域五大宗的中型宗门。
姬云天微眯双眼，只是轻轻敲了敲扶手，看向旁边的一位老者，那老者立即道：“玄冰宫宫主凌霜华，天仙境巅峰，烈天教教主烈阳尊者，亦为天仙境巅峰。”
听到老者的话，姬云天道：“两败俱伤的仗，银号不做。”说完就要回复姬长空。这时姬长空的话又传来了。
“玄冰宫愿意以他们镇宫之宝九曲寒冰阵的阵图为抵押，并且答应战后分润三成的战利。”
这是苍天银号第一次接到战争贷款的单子，也算是给姬云天提了一个大大的醒。前世蓝星，那些发战争财的，无不是短短时间就积累大量的财富。他之前只想着修仙贷，现在他想搞搞武器贷、佣兵贷了。
姬云天道：“战利品我全要，地盘我不要，那个破阵法我也不要，回复玄冰宫，银号不提供战争贷款。但是你问下她需不需要武器贷？”姬云天没有说佣兵贷，因为他现在先想用武器贷试试水，如果效果好，将最近来借贷的散修们选出人选，成立不同的佣兵团后，就可以试水佣兵贷了。
姬长空被姬云天的话给干蒙逼了，快速回复：“什么是武器贷？”
姬云天只得将武器贷的想法细细给姬长空说了一遍，姬长空这老小子，这几年跟着家族见过大世面后，已经不纠结过往了，以前抢来抢去一锅饭，现在才发现，外面到处都是大酒店，还都是可以随时吃的，谁还在意以前的那些呢。
姬云天接着传信道：“银号可以为其提供军需赊销。他们需要的破阶丹药、疗伤圣药、防御符箓，全部由银号旗下的产业供应。战后结算，战利品我们自己派人收取，告诉他们，这是银号给他们的条件，如果不同意，我们就支持烈天教。”
姬长空回道：“烈天教也找苍天银号贷款了？”
姬云天道：“老头，你问题太多了，你干不干？不干就回来吧，我派个比你能干的人去。”

听到姬云天的话，姬长空当时就急了，立马回复：“族长，我能干，你放心，我必把这事做好，保证超额完成任务！”
姬云天没有回复姬长空。
这就是驭人之道，而没有收到回复的姬长空心里跟猫抓的一样，他担心姬云天把他换了，要是真的换了，这个外交部副部长，可就当不成了，他怕丢人啊。
姬长空当即约了凌霜华，告诉她族长有了定计，让她当面谈。凌霜华听到有了消息，快速到了天魔城。
这时座下一位长老道：“族长，苍澜域万毒窟想为他们的少主申请一笔五十亿极品灵石的信用贷，用于冲击渡劫境瓶颈。他们愿意以整个万毒窟的未来百年收益权作为置押。”
这次，姬云天沉默了片刻。
信用贷，这是银号最高级别的业务，也是姬云天身为族长，最为倚重的手段。不同于基层钱庄那种小打小闹的赌运气，苍天银号的信用贷，往往关乎一个势力的兴衰存亡。
姬云天给姜芷柔传信了解对万毒窟的信息，得到的回复是：“小教派，不足为虑。倒是噬魂宗有些棘手。”
姬云天道“万毒窟底蕴尚可，少主鬼手毒尊，天赋异禀，但心术不正。若是旁人，这信用贷断然批不下来。但既然是冲关天仙境，这关乎沧澜域，那就批了吧。”
他伸出一根手指：“贷给他一百亿极品灵石。不需要抵押，也不需要担保。但是，附加条款三条，第一，万毒窟必须开放万毒秘境，允许我姬家子弟每年进入历练一次。第二，战后五十年内，万毒窟一切对外交易，必须通过苍天银号结算。第三。。。”
姬云天的眼神陡然变得凌厉：“若他鬼手毒尊渡劫失败身死，万毒窟必须在五年内，铲除噬魂宗。这是信用贷的代价，也是他们证明自己信用的方式。”
“族长高明。”众掌柜齐声赞叹。这哪里是放贷，分明是借着一个名额，将万毒窟彻底绑上了苍天银号的战车，他们不知道什么叫贷币战争，他们只能看到的是这几条可以为姬家带来的好处。

content_en:
The reason why Ji Yuntian told Qingli was that Qingli was different from Qingyuan. Qingyuan grew up in a big family and had rules and bottom lines in doing things. Qingli grew up in the Blood Beast Valley, and there were not so many restrictions. As long as she didn't kill people and did something, there was no psychological burden on Qingli. After the incident, she would eat melon and watch the show. So tell Qingli about the matter, and Qingli will do it nine times out of ten.
After Ji Yuntian arranged for Qingli, he went directly to Cangtian City through the teleportation formation.
To the west of Cangtian City, on the bank of Yunmeng Daze. This is the city in the sky that Ji Yuntian built for Cangtian Silver. According to Ji Yuntian's idea, this should be the place that everyone yearns for. Ji Yuntian worked all the formation masters of the Ji family to build it here for half a month, using formations to hang a city in the air. The spiritual energy here is like rain, and the laws are solidified. It is the most prosperous core area of ​​the entire Cangtian City, and can also be said to be the most prosperous area of ​​the Cangtian World.
This city is suspended in the air with only the ancient formation, and the four-character "Cangtian Silver" condensed by the huge formation shines in the sky.
In the Cangtian Yinhao Hall, there were no gold or silver common objects, only a long river paved with spiritual stones flowing under the feet. The river was full of top-quality spiritual stones that were cut neatly.
On both sides of the main hall, there were twelve shopkeepers sitting, all with deep auras, the lowest being mid-level monks in the Heavenly Immortal Realm. There are also five true fairyland monks.
On the high platform in the middle of the hall, Ji Yuntian sat in a large dragon chair made of star stone.
Now he is the helmsman of the Cangtian Silver, which controls the economic lifeline of the entire alliance, and is also the current patriarch of the Ji family that has been inherited for 30,000 years. Here, he feels that he is more real. How could the person who was beaten by his mother-in-law and daughter-in-law a few hours ago be him.
The message jade talisman in Ji Yuntian's hand suddenly flickered. Ji Yuntian opened it and heard Ji Changkong's voice. Ji Changkong is currently handling clan affairs in Tianmo City.
"Clan leader, there is information here in the Demon Realm. Xuanming Palace intends to attack the neighboring Lietian Sect and annex its spiritual veins. It has specially applied for a war loan from the bank, with an amount of 30 billion top-grade spiritual stones." As soon as these words came out, several shopkeepers in the hall frowned slightly. Thirty billion top-quality spiritual stones are enough to buy a medium-sized sect similar to the five major sects in Cangxuan Domain.
Ji Yuntian narrowed his eyes slightly, tapped the armrest lightly, and looked at an old man next to him. The old man immediately said: "Ling Shuanghua, the master of the Xuanbing Palace, is at the pinnacle of the Celestial Immortal Realm. Venerable Lieyang, the leader of the Lietian Sect, is also at the pinnacle of the Celestial Immortal Realm."
Hearing the old man's words, Ji Yuntian said: "We won't fight a battle that hurts both sides." After saying that, he would reply to Ji Changkong. At this time, Ji Changkong's words came again.
"Xuanbing Palace is willing to use the Nine-Bend Ice Formation, their palace treasure, as a mortgage, and promises to share 30% of the profits after the war."
This was the first time that Cangtian Bank received a war loan order, and it was a big wake-up call for Ji Yuntian. In the previous life of Blue Star, those who made war fortunes all accumulated a large amount of wealth in a short period of time. He used to only think about loans for cultivating immortals, but now he wants to get loans for weapons and mercenaries.
Ji Yuntian said: "I want all the spoils, I don't want the territory, and I don't want the formation-breaking method. Reply to Xuanbing Palace, the bank does not provide war loans. But ask her if she needs a weapons loan?" Ji Yuntian did not mention mercenary loans, because he first wants to test the waters with weapons loans. If the effect is good, he will select the candidates from the casual cultivators who have recently come to borrow money, and after setting up different mercenary groups, he can test the waters of mercenary loans.
Ji Changkong was forced by Ji Yuntian's words and quickly replied: "What is a weapons loan?"
Ji Yuntian had to explain the idea of loaning weapons to Ji Changkong in detail. Ji Changkong, an old boy, after seeing the world with his family in the past few years, no longer dwells on the past. He used to grab a pot of rice, but now he discovered that there are big hotels everywhere outside, and you can eat at any time. Who cares about the past?Woolen cloth.
Ji Yuntian then sent a message: "Yinhao can provide them with military supplies on credit. The level-breaking elixirs, healing elixirs, and defensive talismans they need are all supplied by Yinhao's industries. After the war is settled, we will send people to collect the spoils ourselves, and tell them that this is the condition given to them by Yinhao. If they don't agree, we will support Lietian Sect."
Ji Changkong replied: "The Lietian Sect also asked Cangtian Bank for a loan?"
Ji Yuntian said: "Old man, you have too many questions. Do you want to do it? If not, come back. I will send someone who is more capable than you."
Hearing Ji Yuntian's words, Ji Changkong became anxious and immediately replied: "Chief, I am capable. Don't worry, I will do this well and ensure that the task is exceeded!"
Ji Yuntian did not reply to Ji Changkong.
This is the way to control people, and Ji Changkong, who did not receive a reply, felt as if a cat was scratching his head. He was worried that Ji Yuntian would replace him. If he did, he would not be able to be the deputy foreign minister. He was afraid of embarrassment.
Ji Changkong immediately made an appointment with Ling Shuanghua and told her that the clan leader had a plan and asked her to discuss it face to face. Ling Shuanghua heard the news and quickly arrived at Tianmo City.
At this time, an elder sitting next to him said: "Clan leader, Canglan Domain Ten Thousand Poison Cave wants to apply for a credit loan of 5 billion top-quality spiritual stones for their young master to break through the bottleneck of the Tribulation Realm. They are willing to use the entire Ten Thousand Poison Cave's income rights for the next hundred years as collateral."
This time, Ji Yuntian was silent for a moment.
Credit loan is the highest-level business of the bank, and it is also the means that Ji Yuntian relies on most as the patriarch. Unlike grassroots banks that gamble on luck, the credit loans of Cangtian Bank are often related to the rise and fall of a force.
Ji Yuntian sent a message to Jiang Zhirou to learn about the Ten Thousand Poison Cave, and received a reply: "It's not a small sect to worry about. The Soul-Eating Sect is a bit tricky."
Ji Yuntian said, "The foundation of Ten Thousand Poison Cave is quite good. The young master, Ghost Hand Poison Master, is very talented, but his mind is not right. If it were someone else, this credit loan would definitely not be approved. But since it is Chongguantian Fairyland and it concerns the Canglan Region, then let's approve it."
He held out a finger: "Lend him 10 billion top-quality spiritual stones. No mortgage or guarantee is required. However, there are three additional terms. First, the Ten Thousand Poisons Cave must open the Secret Realm of Ten Thousand Poisons and allow the children of the Ji family to enter and practice once a year. Second, within fifty years after the war, all external transactions in the Ten Thousand Poison Cave must be settled through the Cangtian Silver Account. Third..."
Ji Yuntian's eyes suddenly became sharp: "If the Ghost Hand Poison Master fails to survive the tribulation and dies, the Ten Thousand Poison Cave must eradicate the Soul Eater Sect within five years. This is the price of the credit loan and the way for them to prove their creditworthiness."
"The clan leader is brilliant." All the shopkeepers praised in unison. This is not lending. It is clearly using a quota to completely tie Wandu Cave to the chariot of Cangtian Silver. They don't know what a loan war is. All they can see are the benefits that these can bring to the Ji family.
